events.title: Death Dealer Playtest: Join the First Wave
events.summary: The first seats at the table are waiting.Steam Playtest sign ups for Death Dealer are now live!If you've been following the game, now's your chance to get in early. Request access on our Steam store page and you could be part of the first wave of players invited during August.We're keeping this initial rollout deliberately small so we can gather feedback, fine tune the experience and continue improving the game before inviting more players.If you're selected, Steam will automatically notify you.
